t:
Section 204(a) of the Food for Peace Act (7 U.S.C. 1724(a)) is amended—
    (1) in paragraph (1), by striking “2002 through 2007” and inserting “2008 through 2012”; and 
    (2) in paragraph (2), by striking “2002 through 2007” and inserting “2008 through 2012”.

fable.w: This section only updates the fiscal-year ranges in section 204(a) of the Food for Peace Act. It creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking authority, or right to sue. The only tempting reading is that the underlying program involves outside organizations, but nothing in this amending text involves a non-federal party in a federal decision.
fable.s: by striking “2002 through 2007” and inserting “2008 through 2012”

qwen_block.w: This section is a technical amendment that updates the fiscal years covered by a specific provision of the Food for Peace Act. It does not establish any process for consultation, public comment, advisory boards, or coordination with outside parties. It merely changes dates within the statute.
qwen_block.s: Section 204(a) of the Food for Peace Act (7 U.S.C. 1724(a)) is amended— (1) in paragraph (1), by striking “2002 through 2007” and inserting “2008 through 2012”; and (2) in paragraph (2), by striking “2002 through 2007” and inserting “2008 through 2012”.

opus.w: This section only updates the fiscal-year range in Section 204(a) of the Food for Peace Act. It does not involve any party outside the federal government in a federal decision through consultation, a hearing, a comment period, an advisory body or a right to sue. The connection to a foreign-aid program does not by itself create participation.
opus.s: by striking “2002 through 2007” and inserting “2008 through 2012”

qwen_chat.w: This section is a technical amendment that updates the fiscal years referenced in the Food for Peace Act. It does not establish any mechanism for public comment, consultation with outside entities, or advisory committees. The text merely changes statutory dates and contains no procedural requirements for participation by non-federal parties.
qwen_chat.s: Section 204(a) of the Food for Peace Act (7 U.S.C. 1724(a)) is amended— (1) in paragraph (1), by striking “2002 through 2007” and inserting “2008 through 2012”; and (2) in paragraph (2), by striking “2002 through 2007” and inserting “2008 through 2012”.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that changing the dates for a program implies a decision-making process involving stakeholders, but the text itself is purely a technical amendment to statutory dates. It does not describe any process of consultation, hearing, or input from outside parties.
